name: Perplexity Comet Competitor Analysis Agent
headline: Live Competitor Analysis with Perplexity Comet:
short_description: This skill helps users perform live competitor analyses by utilizing the Perplexity Comet AI agent to analyze and extract key insights from multiple competitor websites simultaneously. By leveraging cross-tab context retrieval, users can generate detailed competitor reports quickly and efficiently.
author: shyft-ai

sections.overview:
The Live Competitor Analysis with Perplexity Comet skill is designed to empower users to perform real-time competitor analyses by harnessing the capabilities of the Perplexity Comet AI agent. This skill allows users to analyze and extract key insights from multiple competitor websites simultaneously, providing a comprehensive view of the competitive landscape. By utilizing advanced cross-tab context retrieval, users can generate detailed competitor reports efficiently, making it an essential tool for those looking to stay ahead in their market. One of the primary benefits of this skill is its ability to save significant time in data collection and analysis. Traditionally, gathering insights from competitor websites can be a labor-intensive process. However, with this automation skill, users can streamline the entire workflow, producing organized reports in a fraction of the time it would normally take. This efficiency is particularly valuable for product managers and business analysts who need to make informed decisions quickly based on current market trends. The target audience for this skill includes developers, product managers, and AI practitioners who are involved in market research and competitive analysis. Whether you are in a startup environment or part of a larger organization, this skill can enhance your strategic planning processes. Practical use cases include conducting real-time competitor analysis for market research, generating comprehensive competitive insight reports for business strategy, and streamlining competitor data collection into organized Google documents. With an intermediate level of difficulty and a quick implementation time of just 30 minutes, this skill is accessible for users with a basic understanding of AI automation. It fits seamlessly into AI-first workflows, allowing teams to leverage AI agents effectively in their daily operations. By integrating this skill into your toolkit, you can ensure that your organization remains competitive and informed, ultimately driving better business outcomes.
Conducting real-time competitor analysis for market research
Generating comprehensive competitive insight reports for business strategy
Streamlining competitor data collection into organized Google documents
sections.setup: No install command available. Check the GitHub repository for manual installation instructions.
sections.usage:
```
I am using Perplexity Comet for a live competitor analysis. Please analyze the following competitor websites: [COMPETITOR_SITE_1], [COMPETITOR_SITE_2], ... and extract key insights regarding their product offerings, market positioning, and unique strategies. Generate a detailed report and export it to a Google document linked to my account.
```
Copy

```
Example Output: The analysis of the competitor websites reveals that 'Gamma' focuses extensively on user-friendly interface and dynamic customization options, as evident from their homepage and product pages. In contrast, 'Delta Corp' emphasizes robust security measures and scalability. The key strategies include leveraging innovative technology and customer feedback loops. A detailed report has been exported to your Google document.
```
requirements: Claude Code or compatible AI agent
Works with: Claude Code, Cursor, Windsurf
